text: The author employs a third-person omniscient point of view, observing the detective’s narration from an external perspective rather than inhabiting the detective’s mind directly. The narrative tone is analytical and appreciative, characterized by a sense of admiration for the detective’s professionalism. The style is formal and precise, mirroring the "clinical detachment" and "straightforward" language attributed to the detective himself, thereby creating a cohesive atmosphere of objectivity and meticulousness.
